properties.subject: rules_file
properties.condition: a rule object with an unknown key, an unknown phase, an unknown then verb, an empty when, a duplicate id, or a non-string v1 arg is presented to the rules loader or the add_rule tool
properties.guarantee: loading fails with an error naming the rule id, the offending field, and the allowed values; no malformed rule is silently dropped or defaulted into the network

properties.subject: rules_file
properties.condition: a rule containing an or block is loaded, expanded to orN-suffixed rules, and serialized back to disk
properties.guarantee: for every fact set, the union of firings of the expanded rules equals the firings of the original rule, with per-expansion priority, actions, and variable bindings preserved, and a deterministic expansion id set

properties.subject: rules_file
properties.condition: load_rules_file runs while in-memory rules share ids with disk rules whose field values differ
properties.guarantee: after load_rules_file, every rule in memory equals its on-disk record; a duplicate id never leaves a stale in-memory field value

properties.subject: rules_file
properties.condition: a rule participates in audit (audit true) and any save, load, or autosave path rewrites the rules file or the in-memory network
properties.guarantee: the audit flag is preserved on disk and in memory across every save/load path; no path silently drops it

properties.subject: rete_network
properties.condition: facts are asserted with caller-supplied ids and later retracted by id
properties.guarantee: retracting by id removes exactly the fact asserted under that id; no other fact is affected

properties.subject: hook_facts
properties.condition: a per-file hook event carries exactly one edited file
properties.guarantee: a rule whose when clause contains a file_path_matches literal L fires only if the event file matches L; the literal cannot gate a different file's facts (multi-file batch events are out of scope: a documented cross-join boundary)

properties.subject: coverage_hydrate
properties.condition: rules are loaded and an edit event is evaluated at hook fire
properties.guarantee: a coverage, graph, or property relation is asserted only when some loaded rule mentions that relation; no evidence store is read when nothing demands it

properties.subject: rete_production
properties.condition: multiple rules activate in one session
properties.guarantee: agenda order is a total order by priority descending, then activation sequence; firing consumes activations in exactly that order

properties.subject: variable_binding
properties.condition: a rule fires whose action params contain ?var placeholders
properties.guarantee: every placeholder is replaced by the value bound in the matching join before the action executes; an unbound or conflicting placeholder never leaks a literal ?var into an emitted message

properties.subject: beta_network
properties.condition: a multi-condition rule joins facts into a token
properties.guarantee: every token's WMEs jointly satisfy the rule's joined conditions; the firing's provenance bound_facts are exactly the joined facts

properties.subject: alpha_network
properties.condition: the same (predicate, args) fact is asserted twice
properties.guarantee: the alpha store holds at most one WME per (predicate, args) key; duplicate assertion does not duplicate join results

properties.subject: coverage_store
properties.condition: validate_identifier_field scans a byte of an identifier field
properties.guarantee: a byte is accepted if and only if it is in A-Za-z0-9 and _ : . / -
corroborated_by: Mirror caveat: verification/harness.rs proves hand-copied mirror logic, not production validate_identifier_field.

properties.subject: coverage_store
properties.condition: the FNV-1a 64 hash in coverage/region_map.rs runs on input bytes
properties.guarantee: the hash is a pure function: identical input bytes always produce identical output
corroborated_by: Mirror caveat: verification/harness.rs proves hand-copied mirror logic, not production fnv1a_64_hex.

properties.subject: coverage_store
properties.condition: validate_record checks a record's line span
properties.guarantee: a record is accepted only when start_line is less than or equal to end_line
corroborated_by: Mirror caveat: verification/harness.rs proves hand-copied mirror logic, not production validate_record.
